species: 293T or 786‐O cells were lysed with radio immunoprecipitation assay (RIPA) buffer containing 1 × protease inhibitor cocktail. Flag affinity resins with or without Flag‐tagged MFN2 coating (MFN2‐beads) were incubated with cell lysates at 4°C overnight. Beads were washed five times with RIPA buffer and eluted with 400 μg/mL Flag peptide. The eluted protein samples were subjected to SDS‐PAGE or MS analysis.
